name: buckets
sql: SELECT multiIf(BlockedOnUserMs < 60000, '<1m', BlockedOnUserMs < 300000, '1-5m', BlockedOnUserMs < 900000, '5-15m', BlockedOnUserMs < 3600000, '15-60m', '>1h') AS bucket, count() AS value FROM agent_sessions WHERE StartedAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND StartedAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime} AND BlockedOnUserMs > 0 GROUP BY bucket

name: stats
sql: SELECT quantile(0.5)(BlockedOnUserMs) / 60000 AS p50_min, quantile(0.9)(BlockedOnUserMs) / 60000 AS p90_min FROM agent_sessions WHERE StartedAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND StartedAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime} AND BlockedOnUserMs > 0
